periods.text: FRCrimP 45(a): count {n} calendar day(s) {after} the anchor -> {date}
FRCrimP 45(a): count {n} court day(s) {forward}, skipping weekends and holidays -> {date}

forward.text: FRCrimP 45(a): the last day is a weekend or legal holiday; roll forward -> {date}

backward.text: FRCrimP 45(a): the last day is a weekend or legal holiday; roll backward -> {date}

steps.backwardText: FRCrimP 45(a): service extensions apply to forward periods only; ignored

forward.text: FRCrimP 45(a): the last day is a weekend or legal holiday; roll forward -> {date}

backward.text: FRCrimP 45(a): the last day is a weekend or legal holiday; roll backward -> {date}

steps.text: FRCrimP 45(a): the clerk's office is inaccessible on the last day; extend -> {date}
steps.ignoredText: FRCrimP 45(a): no inaccessibility extension applies; ignored

hours.text: FRCrimP 45(a): count every hour from the trigger; +{n} hour(s)
hours.rollText: FRCrimP 45(a): the period ends on a weekend or legal holiday; continue to the same time on {date}
hours.inaccessibleText: FRCrimP 45(a): the clerk's office is inaccessible during the last hour; extend to the same time on {date}
